verses.text: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.

xrefs.text: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and exalt and glorify the King of heaven, for all His works are true and all His ways are just. And He is able to humble those who walk in pride.
Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David, along with cedar logs, carpenters, and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David.

verses.text: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.

xrefs.text: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,

“Go back and tell Hezekiah the leader of My people that this is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: ‘I have heard your prayer; I have seen your tears. I will surely heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the house of the LORD.
He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his maidservants, so that they could again bear children—

verses.text: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.

xrefs.text: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
Surely for my own welfare I had such great anguish; but Your love has delivered me from the pit of oblivion, for You have cast all my sins behind Your back.
Of David. To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
At this, I said, ‘I have been banished from Your sight; yet I will look once more toward Your holy temple.’

verses.text: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.

xrefs.text: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!

And each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and within. Day and night they never stop saying: “Holy, Holy, Holy, is the Lord God Almighty, who was and is and is to come!”
May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.
David appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, to celebrate, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel.

verses.text: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.

xrefs.text: “For a brief moment I forsook you, but with great compassion I will bring you back.
For our light and momentary affliction is producing for us an eternal weight of glory that is far beyond comparison.
Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.

verses.text: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”

xrefs.text: or because of these surpassingly great revelations. So to keep me from becoming conceited, I was given a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.
Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
Then I will say to myself, “You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take it easy. Eat, drink, and be merry!
I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
the king exclaimed, “Is this not Babylon the Great, which I myself have built as a royal residence by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty?”

verses.text: O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.

xrefs.text: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.

verses.text: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:

xrefs.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.
To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by the same Spirit,

verses.text: “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?

xrefs.text: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
For Sheol cannot thank You; Death cannot praise You. Those who descend to the Pit cannot hope for Your faithfulness.
Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.

verses.text: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”

xrefs.text: Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.

For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.

verses.text: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

xrefs.text: Again I will build you, and you will be rebuilt, O Virgin Israel. Again you will take up your tambourines and go out in joyful dancing.
a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance,
Then the maidens will rejoice with dancing, young men and old as well. I will turn their mourning into joy, and give them comfort and joy for their sorrow.
Our God, will You not judge them? For we are powerless before this vast army that comes against us. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are upon You.”
He will swallow up death forever. The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face and remove the disgrace of His people from the whole earth. For the LORD has spoken.

verses.text: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.

xrefs.text: Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
“I tell you, He answered, “if they remain silent, the very stones will cry out.
Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.
